key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:34AE6
name: fill_span_planes_2_3_and
description: For each row between paired span edges, ANDs two per-column mask table entries and sets those bits in planes 2 and 3 while clearing them in planes 0 and 1 of a four-plane screen with 160-byte rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:34B5C
name: blit_span_runs_into_planes
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, sets its first-word mask, minterm and modulo registers, then for each span pair writes edge words to the planes by CPU while the blitter is given a pointer and run size to fill the middle words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:34C58
name: fill_span_planes_0_2_3_pair
description: For each span pair, writes AND-combined edge masks to planes 0, 2 and 3 and clears plane 1; for spans longer than two words it waits for the blitter to be idle, queues the middle run to it, then fills the right edge word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:34C9E
name: fill_span_planes_0_2_3_and
description: Single-call span writer that ANDs two per-column mask entries for each row of a span, sets the bits in planes 0, 2 and 3 and clears them in plane 1 of a four-plane 160-byte-row image.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:34D14
name: blit_span_runs_mixed_planes
description: Uses the same blitter setup as the run-copy routine, but writes edge words with mixed set and clear masks across the four planes before queueing each middle run to the blitter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:34E10
name: fill_span_planes_1_2_3_pair
description: For each span pair, sets planes 1, 2 and 3 and clears plane 0 at the edge words using AND-combined masks, with helper calls for longer spans that wait on the blitter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:34E56
name: fill_span_planes_1_2_3_and
description: Single-call span writer that ANDs two per-column masks, sets them in planes 1, 2 and 3 and clears them in plane 0 of a four-plane 160-byte-row image.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:34ECC
name: blit_span_runs_set_planes
description: Blitter-driven span routine that ORs edge masks into all four planes, sets the blitter first-word mask and modulo, and programs a blitter pointer and size for each span run.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:34FC4
name: fill_span_all_planes_pair
description: For each span pair, ORs edge masks into all four planes; for longer spans it waits for the blitter to be idle, queues the middle run, then writes the right edge word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:35006
name: fill_span_all_planes_and
description: Single-call span writer that ANDs two per-column mask entries and ORs the result into all four planes of a 160-byte-row image for each row between paired edges.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:3507A
name: setup_blitter_line_from_points
description: Computes the absolute x and y distances between two points, picks the dominant axis and octant bits from a lookup table, then programs blitter control, mask, modulo and size registers for a line draw, repeated over four passes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:3509C
name: draw_blitter_line_with_pattern
description: Takes line coordinates from registers and, in each of four passes, selects a bit of a pattern word for the blitter B data register, then starts a blitter line with computed control and size values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:35164
name: clip_line_region_outcodes
description: Assigns each endpoint a four-bit region code by testing its x and y against plus or minus 16383 limits, and when either code is nonzero adjusts the endpoints using stored clip values before returning them.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:3528A
name: bisect_line_boundary_crossing
description: Runs a 32-step binary search that halves the interval between two points, comparing each midpoint with boundary values from the arguments to locate where a segment crosses a boundary.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:35348
name: clip_segment_to_rectangle
description: Compares segment endpoints against four rectangle bounds read through a pointer argument, computes outcode flags per endpoint, and for an outside endpoint computes the edge intersection with division and modulo.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:353A8
name: calculate_line_intersection
description: Computes a new coordinate along a line segment by multiplying coordinate differences and dividing by the segment's slope term, takes the remainder for the other axis, and returns the pair only when it lies inside the given bounds.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:3573C
name: rotate_vertex_by_angles
description: Looks up cosine and sine style values from two tables, interpolating between entries using the low five bits of each angle, then forms the products that rotate a three-axis point and stores the resulting coordinates.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:359DC
name: traverse_linked_node_list
description: Follows a list of node records whose next offset sits two bytes into each record, calling the visitor routine on each node until a negative link ends the walk. Many routines call it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:35A22
name: check_point_within_bounds
description: Subtracts stored origin values from the input point and returns early when any difference falls outside plus or minus 16384; otherwise it scales the offsets down by two bits and tests them against bounds, returning a flag.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:35A64
name: project_point_to_screen
description: Multiplies the input point by a 3x3 coefficient matrix held in memory, checks the depth against clip limits from a table, then divides and scales the result into screen coordinates, returning early when the point is clipped.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:35BBA
name: classify_points_by_plane
description: For each record, computes a dot product of three stored coefficients with the point's coordinates and writes a flag per entry: zero when the value is below the stored threshold, minus one otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:361A2
name: emit_clipped_polygon_edges
description: Walks edge records, transforms each endpoint through lookup tables, clips it against a range and calls helpers to emit the clipped edge segments, incrementing a counter and writing a flag for each emitted edge.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:363A2
name: walk_scene_node_tree
description: Scans a record list, skipping records whose index flag is set in a lookup table, and calls the visitor on each remaining record with a nonzero count until a negative marker ends the scan.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:363E8
name: visit_indexed_child_node
description: Reads a byte flag for the index argument; when it is set, calls the visitor, adds an offset from a second table to the base argument and visits again, otherwise it calls the visitor twice.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:363F0
name: accumulate_indexed_child_offset
description: Reads a byte flag for the index argument; when it is set, stores a table offset plus the second argument into an output pointer before visiting, otherwise it visits twice without storing.

name: run_depacker_entry_point
description: Program entry that, per its recorded calls, invokes the depacker bit-buffer refill and multi-bit read helpers and writes to the COLOR00 colour register. Pseudo-code was unavailable, so the decoding steps are not established.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:0004
name: read_cia_button_ports
description: Pseudo-code was unavailable. The facts show accesses to CIA-A and CIA-B port registers and the custom chip base; the register note says CIA-A port A carries joystick or mouse fire buttons and disk status.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:0182
name: delay_then_reset_status_flag
description: If bit 3 of a global status byte is set, spins a 100-step countdown delay, clears bit 6 of that byte, then writes the status byte to 8. The facts list CIA-A control and interrupt registers as touched, but the pseudo-code writes only the status variable.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:01C0
name: run_helpers_when_flagged
description: If bit 5 of a global status byte is set, calls four helper routines and then sets the status byte to 32; otherwise it returns. The facts also list an interrupt request register access.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:01E8
name: advance_cyclic_state_counter
description: Decrements a global counter while it is nonzero; when it reaches zero it steps a second value through a fixed cycle, wrapping at limit values, and resets a counter to 200 at the end of a phase.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:023E
name: copy_block_rows_with_strides
description: When the low nibble of a global state byte equals 14, copies runs of longwords from one buffer to another in two groups, advancing each row by a fixed stride, then updates the state byte.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:036A
name: update_offset_pair_on_wrap
description: Subtracts 16 from a global state word twice and, when its low byte reaches 240, resets the state to 1 and recomputes two stored offsets by adding fixed increments to a saved value.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:03C6
name: copy_tile_block_words
description: Copies blocks of words from a source pointer to a destination pointer row by row with fixed strides, repeating for two groups, and resets the source pointer to a fixed buffer when a counter reaches zero.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:0416
name: clear_memory_and_setup_copper
description: Clears a large block of memory with zero longwords, then stores a copper list pointer and a series of control values into global variables and hardware registers, including the interrupt enable and DMA control writes described in the register notes.

key: runtime segment $C24210-$C24250:0:0004
name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the first longword from the stack unchanged. It is a two-instruction routine executed during the reference run.

key: runtime segment $C53170-$C531C0:0:000E
name: clear_word_through_pointer
description: Stores a zero word through the address register argument and returns. It is a two-instruction routine entered from outside the static flow.
